D.treatment: system-independent electrodynamics notation close to SI
D.comparison: teaching electrodynamics in a single conventional unit system

O.outcome_detail: pedagogical usability and freedom to work in SI or other unit systems

cells.quote: The notation (21) is used in [3]. The motivation for such notation is a pedagogical one. Such a formulation has also the advantage that one can simplify the life of a student who does not consent the general manner of notation. From the very beginning, one can state the possibility of working only in SI units if setting everywhere c0 = 1. The student can have the freedom to choose the latter option without any repercussion from the professor, of course.
cells.note: The study presents a pedagogical argument, not an empirical comparison or measured learning outcome.
